title: Chart-sum integral candidate for a smooth density
statement: Let $N$ be a compact Hausdorff second-countable smooth real $m$-manifold, $m\geq0$, without boundary [def-sfb-smooth-real-manifold], and use its density line [def-sfb-smooth-density-line]. Choose a finite smooth chart cover $\mathcal A=(x_i:U_i\to V_i)_{i\in J}$ of $N$, and smooth functions $\rho_i:N\to[0,1]$ with $\operatorname{supp}(\rho_i)\subseteq U_i$, where $\operatorname{supp}(\rho_i)=\overline{\{x:\rho_i(x)\neq0\}}$ and $\sum_{i\in J}\rho_i=1$. Such subordinate functions exist by [lem-sfb-smooth-subordinate-partition], applied to the closed set $N$. For $\omega\in\Gamma^\infty(\mathrm{Dens}_N)$ [def-sfb-smooth-bundle-sections], write $\omega=a_i(z)|dz^1\cdots dz^m|$ in chart $i$. Define the chart-sum integral candidate $J_{\mathcal A,\rho}(\omega)=\sum_{i\in J}\int_{\mathbf R^m}\widetilde{(\rho_i\circ x_i^{-1})a_i}(z)\,dz$, where $a_i:V_i\to\mathbf R$ is the coefficient of the section in the chart density frame, and the tilde is the function on $\mathbf R^m$ whose value at $z\in V_i$ is $\rho_i(x_i^{-1}(z))a_i(z)$ and whose value at $z\notin V_i$ is $0$. Each integral is the real Euclidean Lebesgue integral of [def-sfb-euclidean-lebesgue-integral]. For an empty $N$ use the empty chart family and the zero sum. This construction has the cover and partition as explicit arguments; it does not define a density by choosing from an unspecified existence theorem.
